units: Ber. 10ᵇ (expl. עֲלִיַּת, II Kings IV, 10) מ׳ בבתים the most distinguished room (the exedra); Ned. 56ᵃ (expl. העלייה, Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 7:4">ib. VII, 4</cite>) <he>מ׳ שבבתים</he> (Var. <he>שבנכסיו</he>) the best room.
<cite ref="Menachot 108b:24">Men. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ שבביתי</he> (Ms. M. <he>מעלייה שבבתיו</he>) my best room. B. Kam, 16ᵇ (expl. <he>מן העלייה</he>, Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 1:4">ib. I, 4</cite>) <he>במ׳ שבנכסיו</he> with the best portion of his estate; a. e.—Pl. <he>מְעוּלִּים</he>, <he>מְעוּלִּין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 1:4">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ שבמשפחה</he> the most distinguished of his family; a. e.
